title: Lower bounds for linear forms in two p-adic logarithms
relevant_concepts: p-adic linear forms in two logarithms
notes: Journal of Number Theory 266 (2025) 295-349. Explicit upper bounds for v_p(α_1^{b_1} − α_2^{b_2}) with log B dependence, a p-adic analogue of Gouillon. Applies when the two powers are p-adically comparable. At p=2 and p=3 the Juggler pair 2^L and 3^o have unequal valuation, so |2^L − 3^o|_p = 1 and the bound is vacuous. docs/problems/juggler_cycle_padic_coupling.md.
